headline_seed: Zelensky says Ukraine has ‘no interceptors’ as ballistic missiles hit Kyiv - The Washington Post
draft_text:
#BreakingMews: CNN reports Russia launched over 70 missiles and 280 drones at Ukraine; a Kh-101 landed ~90 km inside Poland. Zelensky cites a critical interceptor shortage.

reported by CNN; also covered by The Washington Post
